dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge, with the greatest depth of the spline located at the approximate vertical midpoint between the base and apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex classification with a moderate pixel radius transition between the leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The base width is approximately 1.2 times the vertical height from the dorsal ridge to the apex.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex melon arc with a gradual, large-radius curvature from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a thick base and a length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 150 degrees where the melon slope meets the dorsal margin of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular white depigmentation or scar tissue on the dorsal surface of the melon, slightly anterior to the blowhole region.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced countershading transition with a distinct boundary between the dark dorsal region and the lighter turquoise-shaded lateral/ventral regions.
